assessments.reasoning: The execution reference makes UnboundLocalError depend on two facts at the read site. The name is local to the current function, and execution has yet to bind it to a value.

challenge.method: Compare a read before a later local assignment with lookup of a name absent from every visible scope.
challenge.results: Whole-block analysis can classify the first name as local before the assignment executes, producing UnboundLocalError. The second case follows the general NameError rule. Global and nonlocal declarations change the binding being read.

limitations: Missing names and names affected by global or nonlocal declarations follow their applicable resolution rules.
The documentation claim is confined to the language reference at the Python 3.13.0 tag. The CPython 3.13.5 observations challenge scope and supply context for reading the documentation.
Exception wording and outcomes for class, free, and global names are outside the frozen proposition.
